turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on past questions with did?
turns.tutor:
Hello! You already know the basic pattern here: did + subject + base verb. Let us work on the parts that still trip up strong learners.
One nuance: when the question word is the subject itself (asking who or what did the action), English does not use did at all, and the main verb stays in the past form.
Your task: write three questions you could ask a friend about their last weekend.
1. A yes/no question with did.
2. A wh- question with did (where, when, why or who as the object).
3. A subject question about who did something, with no did.
I will check each one and tell you exactly what works.
